models.name: Qwen3.8-27B
models.why: On AMD the decode speed is decided by the API and the engine, not the card alone: Vulkan beats ROCm by up to 23% at long context on the same RX 9070 XT, while a patched ExLlamaV3 ROCm fork with a W4A16 checkpoint and a DFlash2 drafter reaches 80 tok/s on a Radeon AI PRO R9700.

engines.quant: Vulkan (RADV) vs ROCm on the same card: Vulkan +9% at 1k context and up to +23% at 30k (43.7 vs 35.5 tok/s); Qwen3 14B Q4_K_M, b11177, median of 7 runs

models.name: Qwen3.8-27B (RX 9060 XT KV-streaming llama.cpp fork)
models.full_name: Qwen3.8-27B IQ4_XS on a single Radeon RX 9060 XT with KV cache streamed to system RAM
models.why: A custom llama.cpp fork streams the KV cache between VRAM and system RAM so a 27B model runs on one 16GB Radeon: 42.7 tok/s at ~20K context and 35 tok/s at ~200K, with Q4 K / Q8 V cache, MTP speculative decoding and n-gram prediction.

engines.hardware: Radeon RX 9060 XT 16GB + 24GB DDR5 system RAM (~16GB used)
engines.quant: IQ4_XS weights, Q4 KV values / Q8 keys, custom KV-streaming fork, MTP speculative decoding + n-gram prediction; ~20K context (35 tok/s at ~200K)
